parts.html: The K-18 kitchen model combines a refined grey color palette, clean contemporary styling, and practical furniture solutions to create an efficient and visually balanced kitchen interior.

Its L-shaped configuration provides a functional arrangement of work surfaces, built-in appliances, and cabinet storage, making the model suitable for modern apartments, residential studios, and private homes.

The coordinated grey finish gives the kitchen a calm and elegant appearance. Its neutral character allows the furniture to complement light walls, natural wood, stone textures, decorative plaster, and contemporary interior materials.
The solid-color cabinet fronts maintain a cohesive architectural composition without excessive decorative elements, reinforcing the streamlined character of the design.

A defining feature of the K-18 model is its practical corner layout. With a total linear length of 4.8 meters, the cabinetry is arranged along two adjoining walls, allowing efficient use of the available kitchen space.
This configuration provides convenient access to the main kitchen functions while preserving valuable floor space for a dining area and comfortable circulation.
Without a separate island, the kitchen offers greater flexibility for apartments and residential interiors where efficient space planning is particularly important.

Both upper and lower cabinet fronts are manufactured from laminated particleboard. Their coordinated grey finish creates a consistent furniture composition and emphasizes the clean geometry of the kitchen.
The chipboard-based countertop provides a functional work surface for everyday food preparation, while the main cabinet construction uses 18 mm laminated particleboard.
For convenient storage, the K-18 model includes a pull-out cargo system. This feature helps organize kitchen essentials and makes efficient use of the available cabinet space.
Muller soft-close hinges support smooth door operation, while concealed Muller drawer runners provide convenient access to stored items and maintain the streamlined appearance of the furniture.
The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Cabinet handles are included in the standard configuration, while lift mechanisms are not provided.

DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design and manufacturing services for apartments, private residences, and contemporary residential interiors in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-18 model can be adapted to individual room dimensions, architectural features, appliance requirements, and storage preferences.
Cabinet dimensions, work surface arrangements, and storage configurations can be adjusted to suit the layout and functional requirements of the space.
Our services include personalized kitchen planning, material selection, cabinet manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
Additional equipment, including kitchen sinks, built-in appliances, extractor hoods, and plumbing fixtures, can be selected according to the client's requirements.
